content.short: Crypto/stablecoin business payments and cross-border infrastructure in LatAm.
content.description: Bitso Business is the enterprise arm of Bitso, one of Latin America's largest crypto platforms, providing stablecoin-powered payments and cross-border infrastructure for companies across the region. It enables businesses to run cross-border and local payments, treasury, and professional trading using stablecoins, and issues its own fiat-backed tokens such as MXNB, a Mexican-peso stablecoin transactable on Arbitrum, Ethereum, and Avalanche. Through these rails, companies can move money between the US, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, and other markets faster and more cheaply than through traditional correspondent banking. Serving fintechs, remittance firms, and enterprises, Bitso Business turns Bitso's crypto liquidity and licensing into practical B2B financial infrastructure, bridging on-chain stablecoins with local currencies and banking across Latin America.
